item.title: Secretary of State Allen focused on election integrity during final year in office — 'I want to make sure I turn over the keys in that office and leave it in as good a shape as I can'
item.description: GUNTERSVILLE — As he eyes the lieutenant governor’s position, Alabama Secretary of State Wes Allen is promising to keep pursuing election integrity until his last day in office, come January 2027.During a meeting with the Marshall County Republican Women in Guntersville on Thursday, Allen said his office was doing “some great work” ensuring only American citizens vote in elections. item.title: Norfolk Southern train derails in Valley Head
item.description: According to the DeKalb County Emergency Management Agency, a Norfolk Southern train experienced a derailment involving five to ten rail cars on Friday morning. The incident, which reportedly occurred near County Road 761 in Valley Head, saw Norfolk Southern crews and emergency personnel quickly respond and manage the scene. item.title: AHSAA splits public and private school postseason competition
item.description: The Alabama High School Athletic Association (AHSAA) announced on Friday that it was restructuring postseason athletics by splitting public and private school postseason competition.The change was approved by a 13-2 vote by AHSAA central board members at a meeting on Friday morning. item.description: A Canadian foreign national was indicted on multiple counts of voter fraud after participating in nine Alabama elections, according to Blount County District Attorney Pamela Casey.Franc Neil Maloney, 71, of Trafford, is charged with four counts of felony voter fraud.
